units.heading: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python
units.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a Python-based library for working with 3D files. It is part of the aspose-3d-foss project hosted at aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-Python and supports the Python ecosystem.

units.heading: Supported Platforms
units.text: The library is designed for use with the Python platform, as confirmed by its manifest configuration.

units.heading: Installation
units.text: Install the package using the standard Python workflow: run the installer from the current directory (.) where setup.py resides. The package name is aspose-3d-foss and the current version is 26.1.0.

units.heading: Release Status
units.text: Version 26.1.0 is the current active release, as indicated by the manifest at the root path (.).
